facts.statement: The name Xiyunykus means "western claw" because the fossils were found in Western China.
facts.quote: Xiyunykus (meaning "western claw"; "xiyu" is Mandarin for "west" and refers to Western China where it was found)

facts.statement: Only one species, Xiyunykus pengi, has been described for this genus.
facts.quote: Only one species has been described, Xiyunykus pengi.

facts.statement: Xiyunykus helps fill a 70-million-year gap in alvarezsaur evolution.
facts.quote: Xiyunykus, along with Bannykus, fills a 70-million year gap in alvarezsaur evolution

facts.statement: Xiyunykus shows intermediate features between early alvarezsaur ancestors and later alvarezsaurids, bridging the gap in limb and tooth evolution.
facts.quote: by exhibiting cranial and postcranial morphologies intermediate between the typical theropod forelimb of Haplocheirus and the highly reduced forelimbs and minute teeth of Late Cretaceous alvarezsaurids.

facts.statement: Xiyunykus lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 136 and 120 million years ago in the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, entre 136 a 120 millones de años durante el Aptiense

facts.statement: Fossils of Xiyunykus have been found in Early Cretaceous rocks of the Tugulu Group in China.
facts.quote: Sus restos se han encontrado en rocas del Cretácico Inferior del Grupo Tugulu de China.

facts.statement: Xiyunykus lived in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: en lo que es hoy Asia

facts.statement: The fossil record for Xiyunykus spans from 137.05 to 132.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Valanginian to Valanginian (137.05 to 132.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: Contemporaries of Xiyunykus in the Tugulu Group included the stegosaur Wuerhosaurus, the alvarezsaur Tugulusaurus, the carcharodontosaurid Kelmayisaurus, the ceratopsian Psittacosaurus xinjiangensis, and others.
facts.quote: Los dinosaurios contemporáneos de Xiyunykus en el Grupo Tugulu de Xinjiang incluyen al estegosaurio Wuerhosaurus, otro alvarezsauroideo Tugulusaurus, el carcarodontosáurido Kelmayisaurus, el dudoso maniraptor Phaedrolosaurus, el problemático celurosaurio Xinjiangovenator, y el ceratopsio Psittacosaurus xinjiangensis.

facts.statement: Xiyunykus is classified within the superfamily Alvarezsauroidea.

rejected.statement: Xiyunykus is an alvarezsauroid theropod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous Tugulu Group in China.
rejected.quote: Xiyunykus ... is a genus of alvarezsauroid theropod from the Early Cretaceous-aged Tugulu Group of what is now China.
